confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately well known; accommodation is less certain and sensitive to July high-season demand. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (about 2.8x and 2.4x) because direct local knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from a web search summary citing rba.gov.au pages; the underlying F11 table was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-sized Peruvian tourist cities and highland destinations such as Cusco and Trujillo, with Arequipa restaurant prices set between Lima and Cusco. Accommodation is based on Peruvian mid-sized city tourist rates, adjusted for July, a peak domestic and foreign travel month for Arequipa and the Colca Canyon region.
